caribbean.headline: Windy Seas and Heavy Showers Near Roatan Today
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing ENE-dominant swell with a 7 s period, sustained winds near 19 kt, and seas around 4.5 ft. I expect intermittent heavy showers with 75% rain probability that will reduce visibility and challenge small-craft operations around Roatan and Grand Cayman, where winds are forecast near 19 to 20 kt and seas about 4.5 ft.

mediterranean.headline: Lisbon Braces for Heavy Rain and Choppy NW Swell
mediterranean.paragraph: Lisbon is experiencing winds around 15 kt with significant wave heights near 6.7 ft, a NW swell at a 10 s period, and 88% rain probability. I recommend caution for small craft and expect reduced visibility and localized heavy rain near the port, while Marseille sees gustier winds up to 18 kt.
